categories.main_business_segments: Anhui Sentai WPC Group primarily engages in the research, design, production, and sales of high-performance wood-plastic composites (WPC), new stone-wood-plastic composites, and related products. The company also develops and sells prefabricated buildings and hardware accessories. Its products are widely used in outdoor facilities, architectural decoration, indoor furniture, municipal landscaping, and tourism facilities, with potential applications expanding into agriculture, environmental protection, packaging logistics, transportation infrastructure, automotive, toys, and shipbuilding.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes proprietary patented technologies involving biomass fibers such as forestry residues, rice husks, and crop stalks combined with polymer resins like polyethylene, polypropylene, and PVC. Production methods include specialized compounding with functional additives, extrusion, multi-roll calendering, and digital printing for stone-wood-plastic composites. The firm emphasizes continuous innovation, holding 141 domestic patents including 88 invention patents, and participates in drafting multiple industry and national standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Sentai serves primarily international customers, with over 90% of revenue from overseas markets including the US, Europe, and Southeast Asia. Key customers are in industries requiring environmentally friendly composite materials for construction, outdoor decking, and interior applications. The company also targets domestic markets and is expanding its brand presence in China. Major customers include distributors and ODM clients, with the top five customers accounting for about 38% of sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with significant sales in over 60 countries. It has manufacturing and sales subsidiaries in the United States, Vietnam, Thailand, Hong Kong, South Africa, Belgium, and China. The firm is expanding production capacity in the US and Southeast Asia to mitigate geopolitical risks and enhance local market responsiveness. Domestic operations are centered in Anhui Province, China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sentai operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and processing of wood-plastic composite materials and related products. It sources raw biomass fibers and polymer resins, processes them into composite materials, and supplies finished products to downstream customers including distributors, ODM clients, and end users in construction and related industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation and R&D investment, focusing on developing environmentally friendly, high-performance composite materials with superior physical properties. Key R&D projects include non-PVC substrates for digital printing, inorganic biomass flame retardant materials, and enhanced surface anti-slip flooring. Sentai aims to expand production capacity, improve automation, and broaden product applications while strengthening brand development and marketing both domestically and internationally.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of wood-plastic composite materials and related products. Sales channels include ODM manufacturing, distribution, and direct sales. The company also earns income from licensing patents and technology, and receives government subsidies related to its innovation and export activities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Sentai is a leading domestic player in China's wood-plastic composite industry, recognized for its strong R&D capabilities and broad product portfolio. While the US remains the global leader in WPC production and application, Sentai is closing the gap through scale expansion and technology innovation. The company faces competition from both domestic small-scale producers and international firms but differentiates itself via patented technologies and international certifications.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Sentai reported revenue of approximately RMB 894 million, a 45.25% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 63.28 million, up 32.89%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 1.74 billion, growing 15.19% from the previous year. R&D expenses increased by 15.77% to RMB 28 million. The firm has shown strong growth driven by international market expansion and capacity increases, despite some cash flow fluctuations due to inventory buildup.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sentai emphasizes its proprietary patented technologies that produce environmentally friendly, recyclable, and high-performance composite materials with superior mechanical and environmental properties exceeding domestic and international standards. The company’s products have obtained multiple international certifications (CE, ETL) and are recognized for their durability, fire resistance, and low formaldehyde emissions. Sentai’s global manufacturing footprint and comprehensive marketing network enhance its competitive edge and customer service capabilities.
